summary.value: A brief professional summary highlighting your key strengths and career focus.

work.name: Company A
work.summary: High-traffic e-commerce platform. Hired to eliminate a long-standing content bottleneck, deliver self-service CMS tooling, and lead a major platform migration.
highlights: Eliminated multi-year content bottleneck; architected modular self-service CMS component library; achieved full editorial adoption in [N] months. Reclaimed engineering bandwidth, freeing [N] engineers for strategic work; multiplied content output without added headcount.

Drove measurable e-commerce growth; designed content-gating auth layer that produced significant increases in account creation, login rates, and average order value. Lifted site-wide conversion rate and slashed load times to sub-second performance.

Led zero-downtime platform migration; engineered CMS-to-commerce integration with a custom real-time sync plugin; preserved inventory and data integrity across millions of pageviews with zero revenue loss.

Built cross-functional velocity; embedded with product, science, and editorial teams; translated domain knowledge into prioritized features and realistic timelines. Turned siloed teams into true collaborators.
Mentored & scaled talent; transformed junior developer from markup to autonomous full-stack contributor in [N] months via pair-programming and rigorous code reviews; increased team capacity [N]%.
Institutionalized quality & speed; rolled out unit/e2e testing and error monitoring; cut mean-time-to-detect from hours to minutes and caught the majority of issues pre-production.

work.name: Company B
work.summary: Holding company scaling e-commerce brands. Sole engineer responsible for maintaining and optimizing a portfolio of sites generating multi-million dollar revenue.
highlights: Architected automated merchandising workflow via integration of inventory feed with e-commerce platform for thousands of SKUs; reduced daily management time from hours to minutes.
Built custom SaaS integrations via independent build-vs-buy analysis; achieved significant annual savings and reduced order processing time.
Led product, design, and business collaboration to launch multiple conversion-optimized e-commerce sites.

work.name: Your Agency Name
work.summary: Full-service digital agency delivering self-service CMS solutions, hosting, social automation, and e-commerce. Founded solo and scaled as lead salesperson, architect, engineer, and client liaison; delivered [N]+ international projects; grew to significant revenue and strategically exited to refocus on technical leadership.
highlights: Architected unified CMS for a major client ecosystem serving millions of daily users; aligned content, SEO, ad/analytics, and engineering across legacy systems.
Built and mentored engineering team; established standards, reviews, and workflows while leading technical contributions; delivered white-label platforms for multiple clients.
Scaled high-traffic sites to 1M+ daily visits with <2s load times via CDN, caching, and database optimization.
Expanded offerings to strategic marketing, social automation, print materials, and nonprofit digital-education programs.
